owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Full access. Can delete workspace and transfer ownership.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Full access. Can invite and manage members.

create.title: New workspace
create.description: Workspaces are containers for pages, databases, and team members.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.description: Invite someone by email. Someone without an Oxy account yet joins when they sign up with that email.
invite.alreadyMember: That user is already a member of this workspace.
invite.pending: Invitation saved for %{email} as %{role}. They join when they sign up to Oxy with that email.

members.adminOnly: Only admins and owners can invite members or change roles.
members.personal: Your personal workspace is yours alone: it takes no members.

teamspaces.title: Teamspaces
teamspaces.name: Name

explanation.open: Everyone in the workspace can open pages and join this teamspace.
explanation.closed: Everyone can find this teamspace. Only its members can open its pages.
explanation.private: Only members can find this teamspace and open its pages. Workspace owners and admins can also access it.

teamspaces.defaultInfo: Everyone belongs to the default teamspace. It stays open and cannot be archived.
teamspaces.lastOwner: Add another owner before leaving or removing the last owner.
teamspaces.archiveInfo: This teamspace will no longer appear under Teamspaces.
teamspaces.failed: Could not complete this action. Please try again.

inviteLink.title: Invite link
inviteLink.description: Anyone signed in who opens this link joins the workspace.
inviteLink.regenerateDescription: The current link stops working. People who joined with it stay members.
inviteLink.regenerated: A new invite link is ready
inviteLink.failed: Could not update the invite link

pendingInvites.description: Waiting for these people to sign up to Oxy with the email they were invited with. Let them know: Nilo sends no email.

guests.description: People pages are shared with who are not members of the workspace.
guests.empty: No guests. Pages shared with people outside the workspace make them guests.

removeDescription.one: They lose access to the page shared with them.
removeDescription.other: They lose access to the %{count} pages shared with them.

transfer.title: Make %{name} the owner?
transfer.description: %{name} becomes the owner of this workspace and you become an admin. Only the new owner can give it back.

join.title: Join %{name}
join.description: You are invited to join %{name} as %{role}.
join.signIn: Sign in to Oxy to join this workspace.
join.notFoundBody: Check the link, or ask for a new one.
join.disabledTitle: This invite link no longer works
join.disabledBody: It was disabled or replaced. Ask a workspace admin for the current link.
join.alreadyMember: You are already a member of %{name}
